misleading_claim: Revenue jumped 44.36% in May — our best month ever.
why_misleading: May is the promo peak, picked because it is the biggest; April rose only 17.36% and June fell 13.71%. One month is not a trend.
corrected_statement: Net revenue rose 44.36% in May to PKR 2020840, but that month carried PKR 384160 of discounts and the lowest margin of the half — the jump was bought, not earned.

why_misleading: The base was PKR 24840 — the rise is PKR 20640, about 0.24% of total net revenue. A big percent on a tiny base is a small number in a loud voice.
corrected_statement: Stationery rose from PKR 24840 in March to PKR 45480 in April (+83.09%) — a PKR 20640 move in a category worth 2.82% of revenue.

misleading_claim: The average order is worth PKR 15561.
why_misleading: Discounted orders average PKR 13772 and full-price orders PKR 16753 — the single average blends two different shops, and the promo is judged on the wrong one.
corrected_statement: Average order value is PKR 15561 overall, but PKR 16753 at full price and PKR 13772 on discounted orders; judge the promo on the discounted figure.
